description:
You've lived in your home long enough to feel like you know it. But your house has systems nobody ever walked you through.

Hidden Home Danger investigates the dangers already present in everyday homes — the dryer vent no one's checked in years, the garage spring above your car, the gas present in one in four American homes right now.

Most of it was never explained to you. We fix that. One room at a time.

Built for homeowners who've been in their house long enough to know something's probably been missed.

New episodes every week. No checklists. Just the documentary your house deserves.

🔔 Subscribe and set your notification.
